_comment: TEMPLATE — /iadc-advisor:setup asset. /iadc-advisor:setup writes the real .mcp.json (gitignored) into the app repo with LITERAL values, not ${VAR} — the Windows Desktop app does not reliably expand ${VAR} in .mcp.json. Every _comment key is a note to /iadc-advisor:setup and is dropped from the file it writes. No `iadc` entry here: /iadc-graph:setup owns that block and carries its own template (family ADR 0010) — merge into whatever it already wrote, don't recreate it from this file. No `appian` entry here either (IV-442): this plugin holds no live Appian connection any more — /iadc-advisor:setup instead offers to remove a stale `appian` block a prior version left behind.
